In practice, WB compiles into distinct OpSpec dicts (n_specs unchanged) despite Python-level structural repetition across chunks, so the cache never populated. Meanwhile, the canonical bundle representation shifts dxp_standalone by -40% at n=4 and -45% at n=8 — a mechanism not visible from the diff alone.
